BL_MOMENTUM_001.name: Momentum-only Ridge
BL_MOMENTUM_001.description: Ridge regression with MOM_5D, MOM_10D, MOM_20D only
BL_MOMENTUM_001.role: Primary baseline for incremental IC calculation

portfolio_baselines.rationale: Portfolio evaluation deferred to Phase 24 after predictive confirmation. No portfolio baselines locked in this phase.

baseline_selection_rationale: BL_MOMENTUM_001 is the primary baseline. Incremental IC = IC(vol_features) - IC(BL_MOMENTUM_001). This isolates the contribution of volatility regime information.
